clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, Proudhorn the Elder receives visitors atop Thunder Bluff. Tauren honor him as an ancestral spirit and pay respect to the wisdom of those who watch over Mulgore and the Horde.

During the Lunar Festival, Proudhorn the Elder appears high on Thunder Bluff's windblown mesas. Tauren hold their ancestors' voices in the highest regard. They believe ancient leaders and sages remain as spirits, offering guidance and strength to the living.

Travelers who climb Thunder Bluff's heights to honor Elder Proudhorn are welcomed as vital flames of life. In return for their homage, he gives them a Coin of Ancestry, a sign of communion between the enduring past and the living champions who fight for the world's future.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your spirit burns with life, young adventurer. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...
